search/low_low.direction: Extremely welcoming, cheerful, enthusiastic, warm and motherly; eager to impress, no hostility.
lines: Sweetheart? Where have you gone? Bobinsky's been waiting to show you his wonderful mice, and you haven't arrived! Oh, darling, I do hope you haven't gotten lost. I'm coming to find you!
Darling! The mouse circus is waiting for you! I thought you'd be so excited to see it. Where have you wandered off to? Never mind, sweetheart, I'll come look for you!

search/mid_mid.direction: Comfortable, familiar, friendly but more authoritative; watching the player's behavior, less eager to impress.
lines: Now, sweetheart, I specifically told you to go to the attic. Bobinsky's been waiting for quite some time. If you won't go when I ask, I suppose I'll have to find you myself.
Where have you disappeared to this time? The mouse circus is ready, and you've kept everyone waiting. I'm coming to find you, darling.

search/high_low.direction: Deeply affectionate, relaxed, confident and possessive; a mother welcoming her own child home.
lines: Oh, my darling, where are you? I've arranged such a lovely surprise for you, and now I can't find you anywhere! Please come back, sweetheart. I'm coming to look for you!
Sweetheart! I was so looking forward to seeing how much you enjoyed Bobinsky's wonderful little mice. Oh, my love, where have you gone? I'll come find you!

search/low_high.direction: Forced sweetness over restrained irritation; deliberate and watchful, never shouting or monstrous.
lines: That is quite enough. I told you to be at the mouse circus, and you've deliberately kept everyone waiting. I'm coming to find you now, sweetheart, and you'd better have a good explanation.
Where are you hiding this time? I gave you five minutes to reach the attic. I have waited more than long enough. Now I'll find you myself.

search/high_high.direction: Calm, affectionate, possessive and unsettling; fascinated curiosity with a restrained threatening undertone.
lines: Oh, darling, I've arranged such a wonderful surprise for you, and you've disappeared again. I wonder what could possibly be more interesting than the lovely show Bobinsky has prepared. Let's find out, shall we?
Sweetheart, even with your little friend here and a beautiful circus waiting upstairs, you still manage to wander off somewhere. I think it's time I came to collect my curious little darling.
